item.title: Automatic on-chip separation of partially coherent light into its mutually incoherent components
item.description: Nature Photonics, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41566-026-02035-6 Partial coherence often limits imaging and optical information processing. Researchers demonstrate a photonic chip that separates partially coherent light into its coherence modes, enabling scalable coherence analysis with resources that scale linearly with mode rank.

item.title: [News] Seoul Semiconductor Ends Need for Rare Earths in White LEDs
item.description: For three decades, white LEDs have depended on rare earth materials such as yttrium aluminum garnet (YAG) layered onto a blue LED chip (Figure 1). Seoul Viosys Co., Ltd. (KOSDAQ: 092190) today announced that it has broken that dependence. It has developed and begun mass producing a chip that emits white light without rare earths. Machine learning helps track semiconductor defects under more realistic temperature conditions
item.description: All materials contain inherent defects. These are not always harmful, since they can be used to engineer and introduce certain properties into a material. However, it is crucial to understand how they function and how they affect the material's properties.

item.title: 英特尔代工获微软下一代AI芯片订单，将采用18A工艺
item.description: 据报道，英特尔已获得微软的一笔重要订单。微软或将采用英特尔代工的18A或18A-P工艺为其制造下一代AI处理器。这是英特尔代工在18A节点上首次确认的重大外部客户订单。

item.title: A lensless chip films gigapixel video
item.description: By coding light at the sensor and learning the correlations in a moving scene, a single lensless chip records gigapixel video at a throughput of 20.8 billion pixels per second.
